summary: The user-selected telemetry delivery order makes a facts-and-coverage first release explicit within V2-EFF-01.2/.4/.6, without changing other lanes. Deterministic facts show known delivery/acceptance stages, observed and missing usage, producer/ingestion/publication freshness, actual populations/denominators and unknown amounts; unknown cost never becomes zero. This first release does not await completion-model assessment .3 or explanation calibration .5. Calibrated causal, avoidable-work and health claims, recommendations and savings remain deferred to their own qualified scope; later assessment adoption and whole-feature closure retain installed assessment/projection/browser and functional calibration obligations. First operational acceptance selects one telemetry collection provider, receiver/store, exact coherent versions/configuration/source and tested population through canonical projection to a real browser, with a real item plus separately admitted success, interruption/Unknown, recovery and supported correction cases, never replaying an uncertain original with publication/readback and rollback. Model/Responses enrollment is necessary only for a selected model-dependent behavior. Historical reservations and usage reconciliation remain separate from demonstrably isolated fresh telemetry work admitted through the existing route; old holds and uncertain originals are never released or replayed. Consumers reference one canonical accepted evidence record per assertion without duplicate packets or parent approvals. Cross-item reuse requires exact code, configuration, store identity and tested scope; changed boundaries/joins are tested and final required CI remains. Both facts-only and assessed releases retain their applicable publication, installation, migration, telemetry-provider/receiver, feed and browser gates. Existing one-owner, meaningful authorized independent-review, fast compile/focused-check and credential-separation rules are referenced, not expanded with approval machinery. Numeric resource budgets, tested enforcement and the current CAP-03 custody repair remain outstanding; a dependent runtime path cannot bypass that repair, while independent facts display makes no runtime claim. The earlier V2-DIAG coherent publication/selected receiver and V2-CTX integrated operation/restart/adoption boundaries remain unchanged: comparison is conditional on quantified benefit claims and source delivery never establishes installed use. Existing selected-store migration, configured begin/finish, installed-status and bounded fresh-store ingress/correction receipts remain scoped accepted evidence in the release owner plan and need not be rerun as blanket prerequisites. C2 published receiver binding and genuine emission remain a separate frontier; those historical receipts do not establish current fleet/store identity or complete usage.
title: Telemetry facts and coverage release precedes assessment calibration
